Opened by sec-review-team on 2026-09-12

Our security team is reviewing vendors. When we upload a bank export and the
import finishes, is the original file kept on your side, or deleted? If it is
kept, for how long? Nothing is broken; we just nee

input.body:
label: question
file: none

Thanks for checking. Successfully imported files are removed right after processing: once the rows are inserted into the ledger, the worker deletes the original upload from storage immediately (see the `storage.remove(upload.key)` call right after `completeJob` in `src/ingest/worker.ts`).

If an import fails, the original file is kept temporarily (so it can be inspected/retried) for `FAILED_UPLOAD_RETENTION_DAYS` = 7 days, after which a background purge job deletes it automatically.

So: successful imports -> deleted immediately; failed imports -> kept up to 7 days, then deleted. Nothing is broken here, just sharing how retention currently works.
